name: Riviera Retail and Checkout Fixtures
description: Generic retail and checkout fixtures that ship with Riviera: placeholders at the sizes research note 15 gives, each a model fragment (IFC) with its IFC class and predefined type or kind, so the rule packs choose it. Generated from riviera_core::furnishings (ARC-FURN-001); regenerate with RIVIERA_REGEN_LIBRARIES=1.
author: Riviera contributors

Apparel/garment_rack_4_way.ifc.name: Garment rack, 4-way
Apparel/garment_rack_4_way.ifc.description: A 42½ in square 4-way, its arms at 60 in (adjustable 48–72 in).

Apparel/garment_rounder_42_in.ifc.name: Garment rounder 42 in
Apparel/garment_rounder_42_in.ifc.description: A round rack 42 in across, its rail at 54 in (adjustable 45–72 in).

Apparel/mannequin.ifc.name: Mannequin
Apparel/mannequin.ifc.description: About 20 in across its base and 74 in tall: no source was found.

Carts and security/eas_pedestal.ifc.name: EAS pedestal
Carts and security/eas_pedestal.ifc.description: A security pedestal 0.42 m wide, 0.10 m deep and 1.55 m high; pairs at most about 1.8 m apart, on their own circuit.

Carts and security/shopping_cart.ifc.name: Shopping cart
Carts and security/shopping_cart.ifc.description: A wire cart 43¾ × 24½ in and 41 5/16 in high (Unarco M125); carts nest 12½ in.

Checkouts/attendant_station.ifc.name: Attendant station
Checkouts/attendant_station.ifc.description: A remote attendant station about 1077 × 660 mm and 1038 mm high (NCR, crated size).

Checkouts/cash_desk_compact_2500_x_1250..name: Cash desk, compact 2500 × 1250
Checkouts/cash_desk_compact_2500_x_1250..description: A compact tandem cash desk for baskets, 2500 × 1250 mm and 970 mm high (ITAB CheckMate Tandem); 230 V, 3 A.

Checkouts/checkstand_belted_take_away_15.name: Checkstand, belted take-away 150 × 48 in
Checkouts/checkstand_belted_take_away_15.description: A scan-and-pass lane with a belted take-away, 150 × 48 in, its deck at 36 in (Pan-Oston).

Checkouts/checkstand_carousel_rear_142_x.name: Checkstand, carousel rear 142 × 48 in
Checkouts/checkstand_carousel_rear_142_x.description: A convertible lane with a carousel rear, 142 × 48 in, its deck at 36 in (Pan-Oston); its lane light 2380 mm up.

Checkouts/self_checkout_lane.ifc.name: Self-checkout lane
Checkouts/self_checkout_lane.ifc.description: A full scan-and-bag lane 3068 × 1359 mm (NCR SelfServ 7350, core with bumper, no bag well); its 915 mm deck height is judgement.

Checkouts/self_checkout_pedestal.ifc.name: Self-checkout, pedestal
Checkouts/self_checkout_pedestal.ifc.description: A pedestal self-checkout 440 mm wide, 718 mm deep and 1490 mm high (Diebold Nixdorf EASY eXpress).

Shelving/gondola_end_cap_36_in.ifc.name: Gondola end cap 36 in
Shelving/gondola_end_cap_36_in.ifc.description: An end unit as wide as a 16 + 16 in island (36 in), 72 in high.

Shelving/gondola_island_48_in_x_72_in.if.name: Gondola, island 48 in × 72 in
Shelving/gondola_island_48_in_x_72_in.if.description: A 48 in island section of two 16 in decks each side of a 2½ in upright (35¾ in overall with the 1¼ in allowance), 72 in high, four shelves a side.

Shelving/gondola_wall_48_in_x_84_in.ifc.name: Gondola, wall 48 in × 84 in
Shelving/gondola_wall_48_in_x_84_in.ifc.description: A 48 in wall section, a 16 in deck, 84 in high, five shelves.

Shelving/pallet_rack_bay_96_x_42_in.ifc.name: Pallet rack bay 96 × 42 in
Shelving/pallet_rack_bay_96_x_42_in.ifc.description: A selective rack bay 96 in wide and 42 in deep, 16 ft high, with beams at 6 and 11 ft; anchored, and restrained above 8 ft in public areas.

Shelving/produce_table_72_x_48_in.ifc.name: Produce table 72 × 48 in
Shelving/produce_table_72_x_48_in.ifc.description: A display table 72 × 48 in, its deck at 34 in: no primary sheet was found.

Showcases/cash_wrap_72_x_22_in.ifc.name: Cash wrap 72 × 22 in
Showcases/cash_wrap_72_x_22_in.ifc.description: A sales counter 72 × 22 × 42 in, with a 36 in long lowered section at 36 in for ADA §904.4.

Showcases/showcase_counter_70_in.ifc.name: Showcase, counter 70 in
Showcases/showcase_counter_70_in.ifc.description: A counter-height showcase 70 × 20 in, 38 in high, glass above a base; served across, it is a sales counter (ADA §904.4).
